why: Current OLMColorKey references cover RGB simple keying, premultiplied black-key Edge Thin, and partial Edge Blur/Lab76 scaffolds, but every current case has Enable Replace = 0.
Existing non-RGB cases mostly use a black key, which is invariant across color spaces and cannot verify non-black Lab76/Lab94/YUV/YCrCb conversion behavior.
Replace color, multiple key colors, and non-black color-space comparisons need targeted Windows references before the Mac/C++/Rust paths can be promoted beyond scaffolding.

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMColorKey if possible so existing Edge Thin/Edge Blur residuals stay comparable.
Fully opaque grid with saturated red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray ramps, and some antialiased/transparent edges.
Same color-grid idea, but include low-alpha and zero-alpha pixels with nonzero RGB around keyed boundaries for transparent-RGB writeback checks.

cases.reason: Baseline non-black RGB key without replace.
Baseline non-black RGB key with Color Keep enabled.
Verify Color Space 2 / HSV conversion on a non-black key.
Verify Color Space 3 / Lab76 conversion on a non-black key.
Verify Color Space 4 / Lab94 conversion separately from Lab76.
Verify Color Space 5 / YUV conversion on a non-black key.
Verify Color Space 6 / YCrCb conversion on a non-black key.
Verify per-component thresholds in Lab76 on a non-black key.
Verify per-component thresholds in Lab94 separately from Lab76.
First direct Enable Replace reference with one key and one replacement color.
Determine how Color Keep interacts with Enable Replace.
Replace behavior combined with Lab76 non-black comparison.
Separate Number of Colors / multiple Use Color flags from single-key replace behavior.
Determine whether replacement is applied before or after positive Edge Thin morphology.
Determine whether replacement is applied before or after negative Edge Thin morphology.
Optional interaction check for Replace with Edge Blur feathering; only needed after basic replace cases render.
Optional transparent-RGB/premult writeback probe for the remaining Edge Blur boundary residual.

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM Color Key property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Record grouped Edge Thin, Edge Blur, Key Colors, and Replace Colors parameter values in the same raw property tree shape as existing manifests.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
If possible, preserve the same comp size and source layer artwork used by refs/win_references/20260604_olm/OLMColorKey for at least the current_olm_colorkey input.
mac_follow_up: Run refs/scripts/audit_olmcolorkey_manifest.py on the imported folder to confirm Replace and non-black color-space coverage.
Use the new cases to implement or reject Replace, Lab94/YUV/YCrCb conversion, and multiple-key replacement in the Python/C++/Rust/Mac paths.
